thread:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — I need to swap primary for the first half of my shift, flight delay. Can someone take primary 06:00-12:00 PST? I can stay on as secondary and shadow after landing.
Ravi Patel: I can pick up 06:00-12:00, no problem. @Maya anything active or ongoing I should be aware of?
Maya Chen: Thanks! Only thing was a brief 5xx spike at ~03:40 — rolled back the last canary and stabilized. Left notes in #incidents and the runbook. No active pages ATM.
Priya Singh: quick q — do you have the short-lived creds for the private deploys? If not we'll need to rotate before handoff.
Sam Ortiz: I set those last week. Keys expire in 2 days, so not blocking right now. I'll leave the rotate command here and can rotate if needed.
Sam Ortiz: ```
# rotate deploy keys
redwood secrets rotate --env prod --component private-deploy
```
OncallBot: INCIDENTBOT: Pager cleared for service-inference-latency. No active alerts. Reminder: update PagerDuty rota if you're swapping primary.
Jordan Lee: Copy. @Ravi I'll shadow you for the first hour in case anything pops. Also FYI: watch the A/B rollout flag — if it flips to 100% we may see latency blips.
Ravi Patel: Thanks @Jordan. Which dashboards/metrics are the minimal set to watch during the window?
Maya Chen: Watch token_latency.p95, request_queue_depth, and gpunode_cpu_temp. If p95 > 300ms for >5 minutes: follow runbook 'investigate-latency' and escalate.
Maya Chen: Runbook quick steps: 1) check canary/rollout status 2) check model server queue depth 3) verify KV cache hits 4) fallback to smaller model variant 5) page SRE if >15min
Priya Singh: If you need to escalate, paging policy is: pager->eng-oncall->SRE lead. Use /page @eng-oncall for urgent. Also check cloud billing alarms if autoscale kicks.
Maya Chen: :thumbsup: I'll DM the Jira ticket with context for the rollback and link the incident notes.
Sam Ortiz: Note on scaling dedicated pool if you need headroom:
```
redwood scale --pool dedicated-west --replicas +2
```
OncallBot: DEPLOYBOT: Canary deploy for model-quant-2 started at 05:50 UTC on dedicated-west. Canary health: 1/3 failures logged. Please monitor.
Ravi Patel: I'm seeing the canary failures in the deploy dashboard. I'll hold off on scaling until canary stabilizes.
Jordan Lee: Agreed. If failures persist for 5 minutes, rollback via deploybot or runbook steps. I'll stay on call with you during the handover window.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. I'm switching primary status in PagerDuty now. @Ravi you're primary 06:00-12:00 PST. I'll remain secondary until 18:00 and reachable on DM. Ping here if anything odd.
Ravi Patel: Roger — updating rotation doc and PagerDuty notes. Confirming assumed primary now. Checked dashboards, no active alerts. @Priya @Sam @Jordan @Maya
Ravi Patel: Assumed primary — ready to take pages.
Jordan Lee: Thanks team — keeping an eye from shadow.
Maya Chen: Appreciate it, safe travels. :airplane:
